mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pmis_sensitive_operation ( user_id, username, operation_code, operation_name, biz_type, biz_id, re_auth_method, re_auth_token, verified_at, expire_at, client_ip, trace_id, tenant_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{username}, #{operationCode}, #{operationName}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{reAuthMethod}, #{reAuthToken}, #{verifiedAt}, #{expireAt}, #{clientIp}, #{traceId}, #{tenantId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, username, operation_code, operation_name, biz_type, biz_id, re_auth_method, re_auth_token, verified_at, expire_at, client_ip, trace_id, tenant_id, created_at FROM pmis_sensitive_operation WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY verified_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
